changelog: First release. Structured competitive intelligence pipeline for OpenClaw. Two modes: Quick Scan (5-8 sources, inline) and Deep Dive (15+ sources, saved to workspace). Includes evidence tier system (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/INFERRED), copy-fill report template, worked DTC example, and workspace save script. No API keys required.
